text.p: Profile Technologies Inc said Thursday it has filed six provisional patent applications with the U.S. Patent Office.
The company said the applications seek to expand the breadth of its patented process for the detection of corrosion under insulation for the petroleum, petrochemical and utilities industries.

It said the applications represent advances in the capabilities of the company's high speed electromagnetic scanning process, which assesses the integrity of pipes and pipelines and identifies areas of corrosion.

These applications expand Profile Technologies' existing technology so that data acquisition, analysis and interpretation are made faster; spot checks of specified areas of pipeline can be managed quickly; difficult to reach locations -- such as pipelines under roadways, railroad crossings and insulated pipelines -- can be inspected more easily; and more of the pipeline can be inspected more efficiently. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
